:::{#exr-span-subspace-practice}
#### Recognizing a set of vectors as a span

Describing a [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) by free parameters
often shows that it is a [span](#def-span).
Let

$$
\mathcal{S} = \cb{(a + b,\ a - b,\ 2a) : a, b \in \reals}.
$$

Is $\mathcal{S}$ a [subspace](#def-subspace) of $\reals^3$?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Write $(a + b,\ a - b,\ 2a)$ as $a$ times one vector plus $b$ times another,
then use @thm-span-subspace.

:::

:::
